plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Prompt enhancer for ZCode: rewrite draft prompts into clear, concise, unambiguous instructions via the desktop input-box button, the /enhance-prompt slash command, or the enhance_prompt MCP tool. Supports GLM (Z.ai), OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic providers.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过输入框 ✦ 按钮、/enhance-prompt 命令或 enhance_prompt 工具将草稿提示词改写为清晰、精炼、无歧义的指令(精炼优先,少引用具体文件);支持 GLM、OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 提供方,未配置密钥时按同一规则就地增强。
